strategy.overview: Mystery Castle is a scavenger hunt across five item lanes, with quick Mega Mode starts and the Crown finale. Shoot a lane under a flashing white arrow to collect the current item; bumpers advance the item, while the Change Item standup moves its collection arrow and can also advance the item after an inlane. The first three right-ramp shots light Mega Mode at both the Trap and Pit.
strategy.simpleOverview: Shoot any lane with a flashing white arrow to collect the current item. The bumpers advance the item; hit the Change Item standup to move its white arrow, or roll through an inlane first if you also want to advance the item. For quick two-ball Mega Mode, shoot the right ramp three times, then shoot the lit Trap or Pit.
strategy.summary: Shoot the current item at any white-arrow lane. Bumpers advance the item; Change Item moves its collection arrow, or advances both after an inlane. Three right ramps light both Mega Mode starts; shoot Trap or Pit. Collect all items, then take the Crown for Ultimate Experience.

steps.text: Shoot the lane under a flashing white arrow to collect the current scavenger-hunt item.
Send the ball through the bumpers to advance the item. Hit the Change Item standup to move its collection arrow; after an inlane the standup flashes and also advances the item.
For quick two-ball Mega Mode, shoot the right ramp three times; the first ramp-award cycle lights both the Trap and Pit.
Shoot either lit scoop to start Mega Mode.

alternatives.title: Start Doom Mode
alternatives.when: Use this after the Skull becomes the flashing scavenger-hunt item.

steps.text: Collect the Skull at whichever of the five white-arrow lanes is flashing.
Shoot the open Secret Door from the left-orbit side to start Doom Mode and two-ball play.
Collect each of the fourteen non-Crown items at a flashing Bridge, Dungeon, Tower, Ballroom, or Catwalk lane.
Use bumper hits to advance the item and the Change Item standup to move its collection arrow; an inlane makes the standup advance both.
When the Crown is the active item, shoot its flashing lane to start the Ultimate Experience.

machineSetup: Confirm Rev. 3-era behavior, because earlier software and this game's unfinished edge cases can differ.
Test the five item lanes, both bumpers, both inlanes, Change Item standup, right ramp, Trap, Pit, Secret Door, and ball serve before competitive play.

cautions.issue: Mystery Castle has known unfinished-code behavior and some features can behave unexpectedly.
cautions.response: Use the physical starts above, but do not depend on an unverified scoring value or on a feature recovering cleanly after a software fault.
